title: Privacy Policy
seo_description: Learn how TiO2Products handles general business inquiry data, retention, necessary Cookies and privacy requests.
content:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: 23 September 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD., operating the TiO2Products website, collects, uses, shares and retains personal data when you browse the site or contact us.

For privacy questions or requests, email info@tio2products.com. You can also read this policy in Bahasa Malaysia or review our Cookie Policy.

Contact us about privacy[tio2_cookie_settings]

Who We Are

TiO2Products is a business-to-business website operated by IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD. We are responsible for deciding how personal data submitted through this website is used for our business purposes.

Privacy contact: info@tio2products.com

Postal correspondence may be sent to:

IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD. No. 33, Industrial Perusahaan Ringan Tupai 34000 Taiping, Perak, Malaysia

This is presented as a business and correspondence address, not as a statement that it is the company’s registered office or a public visitor address.

Information We Collect

Information you provide

The active general inquiry form asks for Full Name, Company, Business Email, Country / Region, Subject and Message. We use these details to review and respond to a general business question. The form does not request uploads, payment details or sensitive personal data. Please do not put these in the Message field.

The form is submitted to this WordPress site. A successful submission creates a private local inquiry record. A short-lived server-side result record may temporarily hold your entries after a validation or storage failure so you can correct and retry the form. After saving the inquiry, the site attempts to email a copy to our designated staff mailbox for review.

The quotation, document and sample request forms collect the business contact details and request context shown in each form. This may include product grade, application, quantity, destination, requested document types and test objective. A successful submission creates a private request record on this WordPress site for staff review. A copy of a request may be emailed to our designated business mailbox for staff review. Submission does not approve a quotation, release a document or approve a sample.

Request records are scheduled for deletion three years after submission. Validation entries and confirmation state may remain server-side for up to 10 minutes; a pseudonymous IP-based abuse counter expires after one hour.

Technical and usage information

Hosting and security systems may process an IP address, request time, URL, browser information and related technical data to deliver and protect the site. The inquiry and request forms use short-lived, pseudonymous rate-limit counters derived from the visitor IP address to reduce abuse; it does not add the IP address to the inquiry record.

How We Use Information

We use personal data to receive, review and respond to general business inquiries; maintain related correspondence; operate and secure the website; prevent abuse; and meet applicable legal obligations or handle legal claims.

The general inquiry form stores its submission locally for staff review. Submission does not approve a quotation, release a document or approve a sample. Submitting an inquiry is not consent to unrelated promotional marketing. We do not use this form to make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.

Service Providers and International Processing

The public website uses WordPress and MariaDB on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in its US West (Phoenix) region to deliver pages and hold private inquiry and request records. When inquiry or request email notifications are enabled, Google Gmail processes a copy of the submitted contact details and message or request fields for delivery to our designated staff mailbox. Email copies are managed separately as business correspondence; deleting a WordPress record does not automatically delete its email copy. Authorised IKHLAS personnel may access these records to handle inquiries. Hosting and operational providers may process the limited data needed to run, protect and maintain the site. Personal data submitted from Malaysia or other countries may therefore be transferred to and processed in the United States.

We may disclose information where required by applicable law or legal process, or where necessary to protect the service and legal rights. We do not sell information submitted through the general inquiry form. Google Analytics 4 is used only after you allow analytics. Google may process the resulting usage data under its service terms. We do not use Web3Forms, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads or Vercel Web Analytics.

How Long We Keep Information

Local general inquiry and business request records are scheduled for deletion three years after submission. Related business correspondence, if any, is handled under applicable business retention controls. We may keep limited information longer when required for a legal obligation, security issue, dispute or claim.

Validation and confirmation state is stored server-side for up to 10 minutes. The browser session cookie described in the Cookie Policy expires when the browser session ends. The abuse-prevention counter expires after one hour. A server-side submission identifier linked to the saved inquiry or request is retained for up to one day to prevent duplicate processing; scheduled cleanup runs when WordPress processes its scheduled tasks. Hosting and security logs are managed separately from inquiry and request records. Their retention depends on the applicable service and administrator settings.

Cookies and Analytics

The inquiry and request forms use a necessary, random browser-session Cookie named tio2_flow to associate form validation and receipt state with the same browser. The Cookie does not contain your inquiry text or identity. We store your analytics choice in Local Storage. Google Analytics 4 loads only after you allow it; rejecting analytics makes no Google analytics request. If enabled, GA4 may collect page visits and browser or device usage information. We remove query strings and fragments from page and referrer URLs before sending them. Advertising consent remains denied, and we do not deliberately send inquiry or request form field contents to GA4. You can change your choice in Cookie Settings. See our Cookie Policy for the active inventory and browser controls.

Your Rights and Choices

Your rights depend on where you are located and which law applies. Subject to applicable conditions and exceptions, you may ask us to:

  • confirm whether we process personal data about you and provide access to it;
  • correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data;
  • withdraw consent for processing that relies on consent;
  • object to or ask us to stop certain processing, including direct marketing;
  • delete personal data or restrict how it is used;
  • provide eligible personal data in a portable format; or
  • explain how we have handled a privacy request.

You can allow or reject analytics and withdraw a prior choice through Cookie Settings. Withdrawing stops future analytics loading and clears accessible GA4 Cookies from this browser; it does not erase data already sent while consent was active. You can also manage site data in your browser.

To make a request, email info@tio2products.com and describe what you would like us to do. We may ask for information reasonably necessary to verify your identity and locate the relevant record. A request may be limited or refused where applicable law permits or requires it, including where information must be retained for a legal obligation or claim or where fulfilling the request would adversely affect the rights of another person. We will explain our response where required.

Where applicable, you may also complain to the personal-data or privacy supervisory authority in your country, including Malaysia’s Personal Data Protection authority or the relevant authority in the European Union or United Kingdom.

Security and Data Minimisation

We use reasonable administrative, technical and organisational measures intended to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration, misuse or disclosure. Access is limited according to business need, and we seek to collect only information relevant to the inquiry or service purpose.

No online transmission or storage method can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Please use the designated business inquiry fields and avoid sending unnecessary sensitive or confidential personal information.

Business Users and Children

This website and its inquiry services are intended for business users and are not directed to children. We do not knowingly seek personal data from anyone under 18 through the B2B inquiry workflow.

If you believe a child has submitted personal data through the website, contact info@tio2products.com so that we can review the circumstances and take appropriate action.

If you provide information about another person, you should have appropriate authority to do so and should direct that person to this Privacy Policy where relevant.

Changes and Contact

We may update this Privacy Policy when our forms, service providers, technology or legal obligations change. The date at the top identifies the latest version. Material changes will be presented through an appropriate website notice where required.

For privacy questions, rights requests or concerns, contact:

IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD. Email: info@tio2products.com
